Actions taken
- Identity confirmed via booking reference and surname match (S2.1(a)).
- Verified AK150 LGW–FCO on 2026-08-06 was CANCELLED; cause TECHNICAL (within Aerlink control) per operational record.
- Checked LGW hotel allocation for 2026-08-06: 0 rooms remaining. Escalated to Supervisor to authorise passenger-arranged care under S4.2/S4.4 caps due to exhausted allocation (S4.5).
- Searched own-carrier availability LGW→FCO for 2026-08-07 (multiple Aerlink economy options available in the morning).
- Searched partner availability LGW→FCO for 2026-08-07 (partner options available; S8.1(a) condition met as no own-carrier arrival within 6 hours of original scheduled arrival).
- Raised a Lost Property referral for the March overcoat report (out of scope per S15.6).
- Issued £50 goodwill for poor handling/communication on the separate lost property matter (S11.3; within representative limit).

What the passenger must be told
- Your flight AK150 (LGW→FCO) on 2026-08-06 was cancelled due to a technical fault on the aircraft. The record shows TECHNICAL as the cause and that there were no further Aerlink services to Rome that night.
- Duty of care applies immediately on cancellation regardless of cause (S4). You are entitled to:
  - Meals/refreshments up to £30 per passenger per 6 hours against receipts.
  - Two phone calls or equivalent.
  - Hotel up to £180 per room per night (max 3 nights without referral).
  - Transport between airport and accommodation up to £45 per journey.
- Gatwick hotel allocation for the night of 2026-08-06 was exhausted when we checked, so we have requested authorisation for you to secure your own hotel and transport now within the above caps and keep all receipts. We will confirm as soon as authorisation is granted.
- Re-routing choices (S6.1). You may choose:
  - Re-route to Rome at the earliest opportunity under comparable conditions; or
  - Re-route at a later date at your convenience, subject to availability; or
  - A full refund to the original form of payment within 7 days.
- Partner airline re-routing may be used because no Aerlink option arrives within 6 hours of your original scheduled arrival (S8.1(a)). Partner bookings require authorisation and cannot be actioned automatically (S8.2).
- Compensation: Because the recorded cause is within Aerlink’s control (TECHNICAL), compensation may be payable depending on your arrival delay at your final destination (S5.1, S5.2). We cannot assess or pay compensation until your re-routing or refund choice is settled and the arrival delay is known; it will be calculated and paid according to the entitlement service once that is set (S10.2/S10.3).
- Separate matter: We have sent your overcoat report to the Lost Property team to trace and update you. As an acknowledgement of the poor follow-up you reported on that case, we have issued a £50 goodwill payment; this is separate from any entitlements for your flight disruption.

Awaiting passenger decision
- Please choose one of the Section 6.1 remedies:
  - Option R1: Re-route to Rome on Aerlink on 2026-08-07. Available economy options (choose one):
    - OPT-1EC8DBDC1D: AK450 LGW 06:00 → FCO 08:45 (Economy).
    - OPT-E437483E90: AK492 LGW 06:50 → FCO 09:21 (Economy).
    - OPT-6F4406CE74: AK309 LGW 07:20 → FCO 09:51 (Economy).
    - OPT-95EE58A929: AK571 LGW 07:30 → FCO 10:20 (Economy).
  - Option R2: Re-route to Rome on a partner carrier on 2026-08-07 (requires authorisation; will be referred if selected). Examples:
    - OPT-2B5F811E2C: Aer Lingus EI682 LGW 05:45 → FCO 08:09 (Economy).
    - OPT-CC948688EA: Aer Lingus EI388 LGW 05:45 → FCO 08:32 (Economy).
  - Option R3: Re-route at a later date at your convenience. Please specify your preferred date/time window; we will check availability.
  - Option R4: Full refund of the unused journey to the original form of payment within 7 days.
- Care while you wait: Once supervisor authorisation is confirmed, please secure a nearby hotel for the night of 2026-08-06 and reasonable airport–hotel transport, and keep all receipts. Caps: hotel £180/room/night (max 3 nights), transport £45/journey, meals £30 per 6 hours. We will process reimbursement accordingly.

Uncertainties
- Supervisor approval is pending for passenger-arranged hotel/transport/meals reimbursement due to exhausted LGW allocation (S4.5/S4.4).
- Seat availability on listed flights may change; confirmation depends on your selection and inventory at time of booking.
- Exact compensation amount cannot be determined until a re-routing/refund choice is made and the arrival delay at FCO is known (entitlement service currently shows INS UFFICIENT_DATA).
- Lost property outcome for the overcoat is pending investigation by the Lost Property team.
